serviceAppImports.reason: The payment sidecar still reuses the internal request authenticator until that contract is extracted into a shared runtime surface.
serviceAppImports.removalCondition: Delete once internal service-to-service authentication is provided through packages/shared or a dedicated internal contract package.

legacyZoneModuleImports.reason: The legacy server shell still mounts migrated auth routes while the old route bootstrap is being retired.
legacyZoneModuleImports.removalCondition: Delete once the legacy server bootstrap no longer mounts auth routes directly.

legacyZoneModuleImports.reason: The legacy server shell still mounts migrated billing routes while the old billing bootstrap is being retired.
legacyZoneModuleImports.removalCondition: Delete once the legacy server bootstrap no longer mounts billing routes directly.

frontendSupabaseAccess.reason: Admin settings still depend on the Supabase fallback bridge while admin-console routes finish migrating.
frontendSupabaseAccess.removalCondition: Delete once admin settings flows use only typed admin-console routes.

frontendSupabaseAccess.reason: Billing surfaces temporarily read canonical Supabase balance and ledger rows when the local API health check reports memory-mode persistence.
frontendSupabaseAccess.removalCondition: Delete once the typed billing API remains available with Supabase persistence in all supported runtimes.

frontendSupabaseAccess.reason: Recharge exchange-rate settings still fall back to the canonical Supabase table when the typed billing API is unavailable.
frontendSupabaseAccess.removalCondition: Delete once exchange-rate settings use only the typed billing API in every supported runtime.

frontendSupabaseAccess.reason: User API payload migration still requires one direct profile read while the typed cloud-storage facade is being completed.
frontendSupabaseAccess.removalCondition: Delete once user API profile hydration is served only through typed API contracts.

frontendSupabaseAccess.reason: Secure key storage still reads the profile runtime directly during the auth and secret-storage migration.
frontendSupabaseAccess.removalCondition: Delete once secure key storage is accessed exclusively through typed auth/security APIs.
